measures.dax: COALESCE ( CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Fact_Orders ), KEEPFILTERS ( Fact_Orders[is_cancelled] = 0 ) ), 0 )

measures.limits: co 0 = hoan thanh la quy tac du an, khong chan ly nganh

measures.dax: COALESCE ( CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Fact_Orders ), KEEPFILTERS ( Fact_Orders[is_cancelled] = 0 ), KEEPFILTERS ( Fact_Orders[is_late] IN { 0, 1 } ) ), 0 )

measures.dax: CALCULATE ( AVERAGE ( Fact_Orders[travel_min] ), KEEPFILTERS ( Fact_Orders[is_cancelled] = 0 ), KEEPFILTERS ( Fact_Orders[travel_min] >= 0 ) )
